Routes.description:
Picks the best match among its `<Route>` children.
Declarative mode only — no loaders, actions or pending UI.

Route.description: One route. Nest `<Route>` elements to build layouts, and render an `<Outlet />` in the parent.

Route index.description: Renders at the parent's exact path. An index route takes no `path` of its own.

Route 404.description: Catch-all for unmatched URLs. Put it last, at the top level.

Route lazy.description:
Code-splits a Data mode route: the component *and* its loader are fetched on first visit.
Unlike `React.lazy`, this also defers the loader, so the route's data code stays out of the initial bundle.
